Based on the visual inspection of the time series plot, the data fluctuates around a mean of approximately 0 to 2 mm for the majority of the timeline (from index 0 to roughly 630).

However, there is a distinct shift in behavior starting around index 635 where the values drop significantly to between -10 and -15 mm. This low-level regime persists until the end of the plotted data (around index 740), with a brief spike back up near index 655. This entire section represents an anomaly compared to the baseline established in the first ~90% of the chart.

Therefore, the detected range of anomalies is:

[[635, 740]]
